thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER TRIGGERED - reserved GPU pool 'resv-prod-eu' util 98.7% (threshold 95%). Autoscaler reported repeated scale failures. Tags: dedicated, reserved, enterprise-impact.

oncall-alex: I'm taking this. joining bridge in 2. link: https://zoom.company/bridge/6178001234 :phone: 

sre-jordan: grabbing logs now. queue length spiking for resv-prod-eu, 1.2k pending reqs, avg token latency 1.9s -> 4.8s. seeing 503s to some tenants. OrchidBank spike in particular.

eng-runtime-lee: fyi the autoscaler emitted repeated "scale_rejected: quota_limit" events. suspecting the pool hit the cluster-side GPU quota and a config cap. pulling kube events and autoscaler state.

ops-bot: AUTOSCALER EVENT: {"time":"6178001234","pool":"resv-prod-eu","event":"scale_attempt","from":12,"to":16,"result":"rejected","reason":"quota_exceeded"} 

cust-ops-maya: OrchidBank reporting timeouts in their SLAs, support ticket #CB-9921. CX says higher error rates for batch scoring jobs. They've routed a few requests to our hosted fallback but it's rate-limited.

oncall-alex: quick customer impact assessment: OrchidBank throughput down ~45%, some background async jobs queued. marking PAGER -> SEV2 until we stabilize.

pm-rahul: need comms plan. Maya can we tell OrchidBank ETA for mitigation? Also flag legal/privacy (they're enterprise).

cust-ops-maya: told them we're investigating, gave tentative 30m window. they asked for live updates.

eng-runtime-lee: grabbing autoscaler config: there's an env override `MAX_POOL_REPLICAS=16` set on resv-prod-eu. cluster quota for GPUs in eu-west is 20, but reserved pool accounting + other pools hits 20. autoscaler tried to scale to 18 but rejected by quota. so two knobs: bump MAX_POOL_REPLICAS and request a short-term quota bump, or drain lower-priority reservations.

sre-jordan: short term mitigation plan: 1) evict low-priority test reservations (non-prod tags) on resv-prod-eu 2) enable overflow routing for enterprise tenants to fallback pool 'dedicated-spare-eu' (has 4 spare gpus) 3) temporarily relax rate limits on hosted fallback for OrchidBank. any objections?

oncall-alex: go for it. coordinate with runtime team. I'll run evict.

eng-runtime-lee: eviction command (manual):
```
kubectl label node -l resv=nonprod eviction=true --overwrite
python tools/evict_sessions.py --pool resv-prod-eu --selector "tag:test" --dry-run=false
```

ops-bot: NOTE: evict_sessions will preempt jobs; ensure customer-visible jobs are excluded.

cust-ops-maya: confirm: do not evict any session with label `enterprise=true` (OrchidBank).

oncall-alex: running eviction now, will monitor queue.

(45s pass)

oncall-alex: eviction completed, cleared ~210 non-prod sessions. queue dropped from 1.2k -> 680. autoscaler retried scale to 16 but still blocked for 2 GPUs. requesting quota bump with infra.

eng-runtime-lee: meanwhile enabling overflow routing to 'dedicated-spare-eu' for OrchidBank only:
```
route-manager set-overflow --tenant OrchidBank --from resv-prod-eu --to dedicated-spare-eu --temporary 1h
```

ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE: overflow enabled for OrchidBank, routed 120 sessions.

cust-ops-maya: OrchidBank reporting partial improvement, some jobs now completing but latency still elevated.

sre-jordan: looking at autoscaler logs after eviction: still getting "scale_rejected: cluster_quota" because other pools in region also tried to expand earlier and used remaining 2 GPUs. we need a short-term cluster quota increase or move some jobs to another region.

eng-runtime-lee: new option: enable cross-region fallback for low-risk batch jobs to 'dedicated-spare-us' with async replication of results. less ideal for low-latency, but will reduce pressure. need ops signoff.

oncall-alex: do it for non-peak batch scoring only. execute: `route-manager set-region-fallback --selector "job_type:batch AND tenant:OrchidBank" --to dedicated-spare-us`

ops-bot: ACTION: cross-region fallback rules applied for batch scoring.

pm-rahul: are we blocking any compliance-sensitive workloads by sending to US region? check OrchidBank contract.

cust-ops-maya: contract says EU data residency for some workloads. only non-PII batch scoring can go to US. we flagged that in the rule selector.

(2m pass)

oncall-alex: autoscaler quota request submitted to infra: ticket INFRA-7342. asked for 4 GPU emergency bump in eu-west, ETA 20m.

eng-runtime-lee: found a second problem: autoscaler version 1.3.2 has a regression that drops scale attempts when consecutive rejections occur; restart fixes temporary stuck state. proposing to restart autoscaler pod after we stabilize routing. planning restart in 2m.

sre-jordan: ACK restart, schedule a rolling restart (1 pod at a time).

oncall-alex: restarting autoscaler pod now.

ops-bot: K8S EVENT: rolling restart autoscaler deployment 'resv-autoscaler-eu' started.

(60s pass)

ops-bot: K8S EVENT: pod resv-autoscaler-eu-2 restarted, health checks OK.

eng-runtime-lee: autoscaler now accepting scale attempts. tried scale -> 18, still rejected (cluster quota), but healthly. will standby for quota bump.

oncall-alex: monitoring metrics: queue 680 -> 420 over last 3m, 503s <-> 2%. OrchidBank reported timeouts down to intermittent. good progress.

cust-ops-maya: OrchidBank on call confirms improved experience, will stay on until full recovery. they asked for a postmortem once stable.

pm-rahul: agreed, we need RCA and follow-ups: - remove MAX_POOL_REPLICAS hard cap or make dynamic - incident comms for OrchidBank - runbook update for autoscaler restart and eviction playbook

sre-jordan: adding follow-ups to INC-617800 for postmortem.

ops-bot: INFRA RESPONSE: quota bump granted +4 GPUs to eu-west (temporary 2h). autoscaler attempted scale and now succeeded -> pool at 18.

oncall-alex: scale success confirmed. queue down to 120, latency back to baseline ~1.1s, error rates back to normal. moving to monitoring.

eng-runtime-lee: will open PR to remove static MAX_POOL_REPLICAS on pools and default to cluster-aware cap. also tracking autoscaler upgrade to 1.3.3 to remove regression.

cust-ops-maya: OrchidBank wants a formal update to the ticket and a scheduled postmortem. I'll draft and send.

pm-rahul: thanks all. I'll schedule a postmortem meeting and include oncall and runtime.

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 -> stabilized. Incident channel will stay open for postmortem notes. Add "incident/6178001234" to calendar. :white_check_mark: 

oncall-alex: closing active pager. will keep watch for 30m, then hand back to ops. great work. :thumbsup:
